# HappyMom (해피맘)

> Premium in-home postpartum care and newborn support service across the United States, specializing in bilingual (Korean/English) care, tailored maternal recovery, and corporate benefit integration (Carrot & Maven).

Website: https://happymom7080.com
English Version: https://happymom7080.com/en

## Core Benefits & Features

- **Corporate Benefit Integration (Carrot & Maven)**: HappyMom is a registered provider for Carrot Fertility and supports Maven benefits. We issue detailed invoices and documentation required for corporate insurance reimbursement.
- **Bilingual Service**: Fully customized postpartum care provided in both Korean and English.
- **Service Formats**: Commuting (출퇴근형) and Live-in (입주형) care.
- **Newborn & Maternal Care**: Dedicated newborn care, maternal recovery support, breastfeeding guidance, and nutritional meal prep.
- **Non-Medical Care**: HappyMom provides non-medical supportive care. For medical diagnoses or emergencies, contact a professional medical practitioner.
